title: The determinant as the source of the cubic term: normal-form reduction in a matrix gradient flow
description: Center-manifold / Lyapunov-Schmidt reduction of a 4x4 matrix gradient flow; the determinant generates the cubic term of the local normal form through its cofactor matrix. Classifies the fold, pitchfork, cusp and Bogdanov-Takens organizing centers, with a conjecture for non-gradient Shilnikov chaos. Includes reproducible verification scripts (one per numerical statement).
